TALENTS.//: Skill trees (Battle Re-work Part 3, 2026-10-15). Each class: three branches; a node opens when the points you've spent in its branch reach its tier's gate (TALENT_RULES.gates) and its parent has a rank. 'choice': only one node of the same choice group can have ranks. fx are per rank: acc, att, maxHit, def, dodge, brace, double, stun, soak, trueStrike, magDmg, specCost (share off a special's cost), specGain (energy per fight), ammoSave, runeSave (chance a shot or cast is free), bossDmg, lowHpDmg (damage below half health), openerDmg (more damage in a fight's first round), xpCls (class xp). 'later': a branch that arrives with its class's own part.

TALENT_RULES.//: gates: points spent in a branch to open each tier (0..4). pointsEvery: a point every this many class levels (1 every 2: with three branches a class you can't fill them all -- a choice, as in Diablo. Revisited with every class's third branch, after Part 6). Respec: free to freeRespecTo class level, then respecPerLevel coins a class level, x (1 + respecStep x times you've paid for one).
